fit_assessment_required: CDS versus broad-genome depth and breadth; capture-like enrichment is not proof of a specific capture kit
actual vendor target BED/library metadata when available; GENCODE CDS is not a capture-design BED
coverage at both proposed breakpoint locations, not only inside an exon
matched-platform normal reference availability and sample relatedness
stage6/7 CPU/memory priority and original remaining money/time

candidate_tool.name: DELLY
candidate_tool.reason: Official delly cnv documentation excludes exome/targeted data; uneven coverage must first be resolved

cnv_read_depth_alternative.name: CNVkit
cnv_read_depth_alternative.role: future targeted-CNV design after real capture intervals/reference QC
limitations: Four disease samples are not an automatically valid normal reference panel
Flat reference cannot estimate shared target capture biases; exploratory only
CDS mean depth alone does not establish exon-level CNV sensitivity

forbidden_inferences: high exon depth establishes covered intronic breakpoints
GATK cohort CNV with four samples is automatically adequate
repeat expansion or MT large deletion analysis completed
